overview: Double Lives of Suburban Wives follows six couples in the St. Louis area whose everyday routines from carpools and cul-de-sacs to church and community gatherings coexist with a second, more private side of their lives. Beneath the polished façade, they've built lucrative and unconventional second lives, forging an unexpected bond rooted in navigating lives that many people would never expect.
title: Double Lives of Suburban Wives

overview: In a series of themed challenges, Cocktail Wars pits America's buzziest mixologists against each other in a lively, high-stakes competition with $10,000 on the line in every episode. Each installment showcases a fast, fiery battle of skill, creativity, humor, and flair. From playful flavor combinations to eye-catching technique, the focus is on having a good time, taking risks, and serving up drinks with personality. Each shake, stir, and splash could be the winning touch or the one that sends them home. It's a cocktail competition where the vibes are high, the drinks are strong, and the bragging rights are everything.
title: Cocktail Wars

overview: Calvin Penney is a big hearted but stubborn fisherman living in a small Newfoundland town, who's still haunted by his father's mysterious death from decades ago. When an unidentified sea creature begins terrorizing his hometown, Calvin must fight to hold his close-knit community together. Determined to keep his son Wade and the rest of his family safe, he teams up with a visiting marine researcher to confront the creature and reveal the island's buried secrets before it's too late. Blending local myth, thrilling suspense, and heartfelt humor, this twisty six-part limited series dives into themes of family, community, and change - both terrifying and inevitable.
title: Below

overview: Shifter is set in the near-future, where a banned cosmetic procedure lets people change their faces on the fly, creating a new underground industry of Shifters, who can become anyone you want, for any purpose you can imagine, for a fee. Rose is making a name for herself as one of the best, but the more she gives to her gigs, the more she risks losing herself.
title: Shifter

overview: Chia-kai possesses the unique ability to see the ""connections"" between people: red for love, green for family, and blue for hostility. Yet, he himself is constantly threadless—until he meets Ta-wei, a skeptical detective. Between them, a mysterious silver thread appears, which makes Chia-kai determined to uncover the meaning of this unprecedented bond. As their lives intertwine, the silver thread begins to shift colors, forcing them to confront feelings they can no longer ignore. Adapted from a hit Taiwanese BL novel, Bruce Chiu and Liu Yu-ren form an irresistible paranormal crime-solving duo.
title: Connecting to You

overview: A group of women runs a unique business: luring men to expose their infidelity. Their newest client, Ana, lives a seemingly perfect life with her devoted husband-until doubt creeps in. As he starts to distort her reality, Ana teams up with a loyalty tester, and their search for truth spirals into a dangerous game of secrets, manipulation, and power-where loyalty becomes a matter of life and death.
title: The Loyalty Game

overview: Claire Saffitz is a dessert person. She likes cakes and cookies and pies and believes that no meal is complete without something sweet at the end. In her recently published book, "Dessert Person," Claire celebrates and defends her love of desserts and empowers reluctant home bakers to work with new ingredients, attempt new techniques, and bake with more confidence. Join Claire in her home kitchen as she highlights recipes from the book in this new baking series to help you take your baking skills to the next level.
title: Dessert Person with Claire Saffitz

overview: Drawing upon his experience as a former chief of staff on the Senate Finance Committee and as an Emmy-winning executive producer and writer of The West Wing, O'Donnell gives the last word and rewrites the most compelling stories of the day on The Last Word with Lawrence O'Donnell.
title: The Last Word with Lawrence O'Donnell

overview: Vitalina has been a district police officer for many years and is accustomed to devoting far more energy and time to her job than to her own family. But the day after their thirtieth wedding anniversary, her husband, scientist and professor Anatoliy Rozanov, unexpectedly decides to leave her for his eighteen-year-old secretary, Sveta, who is also expecting his child. Anatoliy explains his unseemly act as revenge. He took paternity tests and discovered that only two of their three adult children are truly his. This means his wife was the one who started cheating on him first. Vitalina decides to prove his innocence and secretly collect DNA from the children-Natalya, Mikhail, and Elena-for retesting. Vitalina moves into each of their homes in turn, diligently setting about resolving their marital problems.
title: Виталя

overview: 1991. A group of tenth-graders goes to Moscow. There, one of the students, Alena, meets a boy, Mitya, who leaves her his address and phone number. But Alena loses the note. 2010. Dmitry Platonov, editor-in-chief and one of the co-founders of a large, successful Moscow publishing house, goes on a business trip to N-sk. There, many business events await him, including an interview for a local newspaper. The journalist turns out to be that very Alena. Dmitry doesn't recognize her: the 16-year-old girl has become a beautiful woman. She has loved him all these years and recognizes him immediately, but doesn't want to admit it…
title: Время для двоих

overview: Samantha is a 1998 Venezuelan telenovela produced by Venevisión. The story follows Samantha, a free-spirited country girl who saves a wealthy playboy, Luis Alberto, from a plane crash. They fall in love, but their romance is threatened by dangerous family secrets, ruthless rivals, and Luis Alberto's memory loss.
title: Samantha

overview: Mi querida Isabel is a Mexican telenovela that centers on Isabel Rivas, a simple, beautiful and happy young girl and a dedicated law student who supports her dysfunctional family following the presumed death of her mother two decades earlier. Her family is noble and affectionate but her father hides his addiction to the alcohol and the truth about the mother of Isabel and Marcos, who is alive and unjustly put in jail. Her younger brother Marcos pursues a rebellious lifestyle focused on music and easy money. While working as a waitress in the university, Isabel meets a nice guy, Juan Daniel. A beautiful, pure and enthusiastic love starts between Juan Daniel and Isabel. Juan Daniel is an architect who is meant to be successful. His family is rich and lives in luxury, but also they have their own secrets. The mother of Juan Daniel is a dominant and bitter widow who controls the life of her children. The core plot revolves around Isabel's involvement in the case of Sagrario, a woman imprisoned for 20 years on charges of murder she insists she did not commit. Unaware of their blood relation, Isabel fights to prove Sagrario's innocence and ultimately welcomes her into the family home upon her release.
title: Mi querida Isabel

overview: It is a tale of how love can bring light and gloom in a person's life and how a deep, dark secret can make or break the blooming relationship between Michelle and Adrian. Michelle is a girl with a bright and sunny disposition. Despite the hardships in life, she managed to get by because her Mamay and Papay taught her always to see the good in every situation. She has her eyes set on bagging the Tranquila Resort account because it will boost her career. Adrian's life, on the other hand, is full of darkness. He is the CEO of the Olvidar Group of Companies, of which Tranquila Resort, a vacation spot situated in El Paraiso, is part. Because of a sin he committed 18 years ago, he is considered a beast by his employees and an outcast in his home town. Michelle and Adrian start on the wrong foot, and as they cross paths again, Michelle learns that Adrian is the owner of Tranquila Resort. As she sets foot on the island of El Paraiso, she finds out about Adrian's life and the mystery behind the lighthouse she has been dreaming of. What is the relation of El Paraiso to Michelle's dream? As Mich enters Adrian's life, will she be the light that will make his life bright again?
title: Araw Gabi

overview: Inés and Luis Guillermo... Marisela and Diego Andrés... Two love stories unfolding against the backdrop of a fierce struggle between two prominent families: the Núñez and the Malavés.
title: Cuando hay pasión

overview: I Left My Heart in Sorsogon is a romance-drama story about Celeste, a young woman from Sorsogon who has reinvented herself in Manila as a fashion designer and socialite. Celeste is successful on both the personal and professional front. Aside from being a celebrated fashion designer, she is also the toast of high society as she is dating the most eligible bachelor around, Tonito Wenceslao III. For some unexpected reason, Celeste finds herself coming back to her hometown, Sorsogon, to take care of some family matters. While in Sorsogon, Celeste looks back on her previous life there, and makes a discovery about herself. She also unexpectedly crosses paths again with her ex-boyfriend, Mikoy. Will Celeste choose the bright lights of Manila with Tonito or will she leave her heart and live a possibly quieter life in Sorsogon with Mikoy?
title: I Left My Heart in Sorsogon

overview: First Yaya is the aspirational, fairy-tale-like story of an ordinary woman who gets to lead an extraordinary life as the nanny of the children of a widower Philippine Vice-President who eventually becomes the President by accession and election. Despite social and familial obstacles and struggles, the bond between yaya Melody Reyes and country leader Glenn Acosta prevails and blossoms into something beautiful, heart-warming, and exciting. But unbeknown to them, a dark secret from the past—involving both their families—could possibly destroy their intricate and already-complicated relationship, forever threatening their "happily- ever-after".
title: First Yaya

overview: Jonathan Dimbleby explores ten thousand miles of one of the world's most awe-inspiring countries.
title: Russia: A Journey with Jonathan Dimbleby

overview: In a post-pandemic world, gene therapy has saved the human race from disease but has given birth to Variants: people with powers so unique, the government denies their human rights.
title: Heart Attack

overview: Solterita y a la orden follows the entertaining life of Valeria, a woman who decides to stay single and focus on her success. Her life changes when a handsome radio host becomes obsessed with winning her heart, sparking a fun-filled battle between love and freedom.
title: Solterita y a la orden

overview: A young woman struggles to discover her true origins and find her place in the world, while confronting the secrets of her past and discovering true love.
title: Un nuevo amor

overview: A fashion show, wedding story, and family therapy all in one; Say Yes To The Dress: Benelux. In one of the best bridal salons in the Netherlands, a team of advisors guides brides-to-be through the wedding!
title: Say Yes to the Dress: Benelux

overview: Approach to the vital and historical trajectory of one of the fundamental characters in the history of France, decisive for the centralization of the state and the consolidation of Catholicism throughout the country. Relentless, of an exceptional political and military intelligence and very influential in the reign of Louis XIII, of which he was not a simple prime minister. Crossed out and reputed to be a despot, ambitious, harsh and cruel, perhaps there was some truth in it. Alexander Dumas and his musketeers gave him some visibility.
title: Richelieu

overview: A love story interwoven with supernatural elements, drama, humour, and the struggle between good and evil.
title: O Beijo do Vampiro

overview: USSR, 1983. Dina goes for an internship at a medical hospital in Afghanistan and faces not only the horrors of war, but also true love, which seems to have no place on this earth. Officer Gerasimov, saved by Dina, sees in her the meaning of his life and is ready to risk everything just to be with her. Having learned that Dina is in danger, he goes to a distant mountain outpost and enters into a dangerous battle to save his beloved.
title: Вернуть любой ценой

overview: Marasri is the most beautiful girl in the countryside and her father is the richest man. However, she has a difficult and proud temper and is crazy about likay, which makes it difficult for people to get along with her. She's madly in love with a likay actor, Wichan, to the despair of her father who won't have a likay actor as his son-in-law. So when Lieutenant Anon comes in town on an undercover mission to secretly investigate a murder in a likay troupe, under the fake identity of Nai Mai, a simple worker, her father sees an opportunity. Marasri's father hires Anon to protect her, but in fact, he hopes to matchmake them. Like that, not only his precious daughter will stop being obsessed about likay actors and won't bring him one at home, in addition, he'll have a strong police officer as a son-in-law to protect his daughter!
title: Khung Saneha

overview: A simple guy meets a charming damsel who cons him out of his car, leading to unexpected twists and dramatic consequences involving his overbearing father and a staged romance at their resort.
title: Love Adhura

overview: Each episode of UFC Fight Flashback is an enhanced replay of one of the greatest bouts in the history of the Ultimate Fighting Championship.
title: UFC Fight Flashback

overview: A series which follows the reality of rural society. It tells the story about the lovely Thai native soccer team and the problem in the village and the culture of the northeastern part of Thailand.
title: Thibaan in Love

overview: Since assuming the role of the country's First Lady, Melody becomes overwhelmed by all the changes and the responsibilities she now holds. As she tries to emulate past First Ladies, Melody learns that she can just be herself, despite holding a prestigious role in the government. However, with her Princess Diana-like appeal to the masses, the close confidantes of President Glenn Acosta worry that the First Lady may overshadow his presidential campaign.
title: First Lady

overview: At age 40 Tom Brady is taking on his toughest opponent yet: time. Watch as he balances his growth on the field with fatherhood, fortyhood and life in the spotlight. Follow Tom Brady on his journey vs. time.
title: Tom vs Time

overview: Thongdee was transferred to Ban Huai Jorakhe after opposing a crime backed by a powerful figure. There, he meets Ploy, the daughter of Preecha, whom Thongdee suspects of being involved in illegal activities. Ploy, disillusioned with the police, believes there are no good cops left and fights for justice and equality against powerful criminals. When Thongdee learns of his superior's corruption, he realises he must battle both the criminals and the corrupt officers.
title: The Brave Man

overview: The story takes place in 1910 in Montreal, Quebec, while a killer terrorized the city. In the same period, Florence and Camille Courval, two sisters originating in French Manitoba inherit the Eden Museum, where statues of wax in connection with criminal news are housed.
title: Musée Eden

overview: YouTuber Soda has made a fortune selling products online. She's an incredible saleswoman, beautiful, smart, confident, has tons of friends, is an excellent problem-solver, and has many admirers. The man she's about to marry, however, is just an ordinary veterinarian, Dindaen. Dindaen specialises in cattle breeding. He's easygoing, unpretentious, genuine, straightforward and harmless. None of Soda's friends care for Dindaen, but no one can change her mind. When the couple start to feel unsure about each other before their wedding ceremony, their rings miraculously transport the two back in time to prove their love, stability, and vows.
title: The Soulmate Rings

overview: The story revolves around 4 people named Shivin, Gauri, Ahan, and Kia. Gauri is a lower class girl who has a passion for education, while Shivin, Ahan, and Kia are rich kids of business parents. Shivin and Ahan were best friends until a series of miscommunication caused Ahan to get angry on Shivin, although it was never his fault. This causes Shivin to get angry on his mother thinking it is her fault, but the truth is she is also innocent. Gauri bumps into Ahan a few times, so they start to lightly recognize each other. On the other hand, Gauri and Shivin meets through some misunderstandings which causes Gauri to have a bad image of Shivin, but in reality, Shivin is a very down-to-earth guy who cares for people. The misunderstanding is soon sorted out when Shivin saves Gauri from goons and shelters her for a while in his house.
title: Kahani Hamari... Dil Dosti Deewanepan Ki

overview: Recipes Donal knows his own family will devour — from smoky chicken tacos to speedy pastas. A blueprint for managing the madness life throws at you and still getting supper on the table.
title: Donal's Family Kitchen

overview: Ready. Daddy. Go! follows Michel, a gay man unexpectedly left by his husband. Despite having nothing, he refuses to give up his dream of becoming a father, exploring adoption, surrogacy, and new love as a newly single parent.
title: Ready. Daddy. Go!

overview: Ellis and Brecht seem like a dream couple. Until Brecht suddenly decides to take a time-out. One month without a relationship and job to figure out what he wants.
title: Time:out

overview: No Tomorrow centers on Evie, a risk-averse quality-control assessor who falls for free-spirited thrill seeker Xavier - only to find out he lives his life that way because he believes the apocalypse is coming. No Tomorrow is described as a romantic comedy with the ultimate ticking clock (8 months and 12 days, to be exact).
title: No Tomorrow

overview: The turquoise waters of the Mediterranean are home to exceptional biodiversity. Join researchers studying the seabed to better protect it on a dive to discover the aquatic plants of Port-Cros Island and the powerful currents of the Strait of Messina—not to mention the large marine mammals of the Pelagos Sanctuary, where dolphins, whales, fin whales, and sperm whales are right at home.
title: La Méditerranée révélée

overview: La mujer de Lorenzo follows Laurita, an elegant socialite who plots to make her rich and devoted husband, Lorenzo, fall in love with another woman. She does this to dodge a strict pre-nup so she can leave him for her personal trainer without losing her massive fortune.
title: La mujer de Lorenzo

overview: Popular nineties television idols with a passion for design and renovation will go step by step back into the iconic decade as they search for America's homes frozen in time. Totally ‘90s House a true blast from the past will follow two celeb teams as they scour the country for houses stuck in the 1990s—think honey oak cabinets, sponge-painted walls and mirrored closets—with each team ultimately picking their perfect throwback in need of a major overhaul.
title: Totally ‘90s House

overview: Behind every woman stands an insecure man. Or so it seems in the comedy series about the Hendrickx family, headed by ex-commissioner Marcel and businesswoman Rita. Their three daughters each lead their own lives, together with their partners. The sons-in-law and son Jeroen form the "Kloefkappers" and discuss their lives weekly at the bowling alley. As long as the men are together, they feel on top of the world and their self-confidence knows no bounds. Then they can handle any problem – or so they think. Once left to their own devices again, however, they quickly transform back into those hesitant creatures desperately trying to keep their heads above water. Fortunately, behind each of our insecure men stands a strong woman who does know how to handle things, and her husband. It is this age-old tension between the sexes that provides the very recognizable humor in Strike.
title: Strike!

overview: A mother, Qin Mu Xuan, reconnects with a cold-blooded CEO, Gu Zi Jin, years after a conspiracy separated them, forcing them together for the sake of their secret, adorable young son, Qin Xiao
title: Oh! My Dreamy Daddy

overview: Three brave brothers are humiliated by the brutal Sua Int of Huaysuarong. Kan, Krieng and Krai have to break the oath to remain peaceful. Their hearts are also burning as their girls leave them for their foes, especially Waree, Kan's number-one enemy. The three brothers have to remain courageous in this tough combat.
title: The Tiger's Path

overview: World War Two was a conflict of immeasurable scale, a Total War, laying waste to entire nations, changing the world forever. From this devastation, new powers would emerge. Allies would become enemies, an Iron Curtain would fall across Europe, and a Cold War would begin. Who were the great players that shaped the modern world, and how did the Cold War emerge from the Endgame of World War Two? World War II: Endgame is a four-part series combining military history and big picture geopolitics. It's the story of the "Grand Alliance" of World War Two, the unlikely team of Great Britain, the Soviet Union and the US that came together to defeat Hitler's Nazi regime, before fracturing and turning on itself. With expert interviews, archival footage brought to life by cutting edge colourisation, this series explores the origins of a conflict that took the world to the edge of Armageddon.
title: World War II: Endgame

overview: The Cadburys is a warm-hearted family drama following the visionary Cadbury family, the underdogs of the cocoa world, on their journey towards creating the world-famous Cadbury's chocolate bar. In 1860s Birmingham, when chocolate as we know it doesn't yet exist, two very different brothers, Richard and George Cadbury, find themselves in charge of their family's failing cocoa business. Between them, they have the radical genius and burning ambition to turn Cadbury's into one of the world's most beloved confectioners. But first, they must learn to trust and rely on each other. And to stop bickering for long enough to actually invent some chocolate! Their sister Maria is navigating her own role within the family and the business, but things become even more complicated when she falls in love with Cadbury's biggest rival, and is forced to question where her true loyalties really lie. Infused with historical delights and magical invention, The Cadburys is about how we build, break and rebuild the bonds of family - and how the sweetest things in life are rarely simple.
title: The Cadburys

overview: A special project of the St. Petersburg TV channel about the historical districts of the city, with their mood, cultural environment and iconic architectural objects. "Small Motherlands" are the districts of St. Petersburg where the city began and continues. The history of the place and time, together with the authors of the program, is told by St. Petersburg residents: old-timers, local historians, writers, actors, artists.
title: Малые родины большого Петербурга

overview: Based on the novel by James. London. About the collision of strong characters, love and outcast among men, doomed to loneliness and misunderstanding.
title: Морской волк

overview: Cops with Cameras follows different police forces as they conduct their work around the country.
title: Cops with Cameras

overview: In the Kuban town of Lushchinskaya, law and order are not exercised by local autonomy but by the Volkov clan, headed by "Donya" Nadezhda Alekseevna Volkova and her eldest son, Nikolai, who will be the protagonists of creating a tragedy.
title: Станица

overview: A woman loses custody of her child, a girl left in an orphanage by her impatient aunt. The girl escapes and is sheltered by a sweethearted elder, while her mother fights to get her back.
title: Sonho Meu

overview: Chicks is a two-hander dramedy set in the rapidly gentrifying neighborhoods of old Boston. The show follows Chickie and Doreen, two estranged half-sisters who are both struggling to get by when their wise guy dad unexpectedly kicks the bucket. Their only inheritance is a legacy of two-bit crime that inspires them to run increasingly audacious frauds. As their con grows, so does their odd-couple bond, as they each start to fill the father-shaped hole in the other's heart.
title: Chicks
A Mountain Can Hold Two Tigers

overview: Behind Bars: Officer Cam takes viewers inside two of the country's most pressurized correctional facilities, where sheriffs equip every officer with body-worn cameras to transform how their jails operate. Through raw, first-hand footage, the series reveals what it takes to run a modern American jail. Once viewed primarily as tools of oversight, bodycams have become catalysts for change—driving smarter training, stronger decision-making, and safer outcomes for officers and inmates alike.
title: Behind Bars: Officer Cam

overview: Super Market is the new Italian Prime Original comedy series written and directed by the collective Il Terzo Segreto di Satira on the tragicomic events of Eury, a chaotic neighborhood supermarket that risks closure.
title: Super Market

overview: A sensitive and intelligent woman begins working at the company of a powerful, manipulative man, sparking a tangled love triangle filled with secrets and deception.
title: Caminos cruzados

overview: Walking with Dinosaurs is a six-part documentary television miniseries that was produced by the BBC, narrated by Kenneth Branagh, and first aired in the United Kingdom, in 1999.
title: Walking with Dinosaurs

overview: After the murder of her father and brother, Irene Saldivar travels to Greece. There she meets and falls in love with entrepreneur Alexis Theodorakis. Carlos is the administrator of Irene's fortune and cooperates with Alejandro in a rotten and corrupt business where he marries rich women, kills them, and obtains their fortune. When Carlos finds out about Irene's marriage to Alexis, he formulates a plan to kill Alexis and obtain his fortune. During Irene and Alexis' honeymoon, Carlos' plan succeeds when the boat Alexis travels in explodes. A desperate and pregnant Irene returns to Mexico, where she falls in love with Dr. Diego Covarrubias. However, Irene is forced to leave him for the sake of her friend Carolina, since Carolina loves him and has cancer. Since Alejandro isn't able to win Irene's love, Alejandro gets in her life and forces her to marry him or risk losing her son - all of this as part of another plan Carlos formulated so he and Alejandro plot Irene's death in another fatal catastrophe.
title: Bajo un mismo rostro

overview: La dama del norte tells the incredible story of Diana García, a young woman who flees to Madrid to escape a terrible past and who, together with her friends Penélope and Maricarmen, ends up leading one of the most ruthless drug cartels in 1990s Spain. In a world ruled by men, Diana prevails where they fall: she negotiates, she leads, and she survives. But her power begins to waver when Detective Medina — the only one capable of seeing the woman behind the criminal legend — crosses her path. The relationship between Diana and Medina, as intense as it is impossible, will put their loyalties in check: as the police and the cartel tighten the noose, both must choose between justice, revenge… or a love that could doom them both.
title: La dama del norte

overview: Alberto detests his mother-in-law, Elvira, and finds himself in desperate situations without realizing that she and her children are sorcerers. His wife, Amanda, gave up her supernatural powers to lead a normal life with him but has to deal with her mother's constant interference. Origin: The comedy is a humorous, partial adaptation of the famous classic American series *Bewitched*
title: A Minha Sogra é Uma Bruxa
Bao An Dai Dui Peng Qi Da Li Shen Bei

overview: The story of Seis Hermanas takes place in 1913. The Silva sisters are the life of high-society gatherings. Beautiful, well-mannered, kind, and refined, the six sisters enjoy a trouble-free existence until a terrible event changes their lives forever.
title: Seis hermanas

overview: What happens when your worst enemy is the only person who can help you? In Ontwaak, the story revolves around Melissa Human, a psychiatrist who starts working at Noordlig, a home for extremely dangerous patients. But behind the high walls, more than just patients await her. She discovers a sinister cult, Horisonne, that has taken in her daughter, and is led by her ex-fiancé.To save her daughter, Melissa must cross her own boundaries and rely on a brilliant serial killer. However, every answer leads to a new danger; every choice has a price. This is not just a fight against a cult – it's a fight against the darkest depths of the self.
title: Ontwaak

overview: "Walking with Monsters" is a documentary films series about life in the Paleozoic, bringing to life extinct arthropods, fish, amphibians, synapsids, and reptiles. As with previous Walking with... instalments, it is narrated by Kenneth Branagh. Using state-of-the-art visual effects, this prequel to Walking with Dinosaurs shows an epic 300 million year war between creatures before the dinosaurs.
title: Walking with Monsters

overview: Filmmaker Eric Goode follows his first love – reptiles – into the dark and gonzo underworld of exotic animal smuggling. In this global network, everyone is chasing the ultimate prize, whether it be owning the rarest of species, claiming the biggest fortunes, or taking down the most elusive criminals. The billion-dollar criminal enterprise is fueled by extreme obsession for these creatures, driving many to push the boundaries of laws and environmental ethics. As he digs deeper, Goode uncovers a labyrinth of outlaw traffickers, bombastic collectors, and the dogged law enforcement agents on their tails. Unfolding over decades, Monsters of God traces the evolution of the reptile trade as it skirts the Endangered Species Act of 1973 and grows into a secretive, high-stakes world of backroom dealings and fanatical collectors. With unprecedented access to the major players, from traffickers to animal enthusiasts to federal agents, Goode unravels a web of larger-than-life characters who run a complex international crime ring. A thrilling exposé of a hidden underworld, Monsters of God warns of the devastating impact of the insatiable desire for the forbidden, and how this mad obsession is pushing some species to the brink of extinction.
title: Monsters of God

overview: Single father Melker Melkersson spends summer vacations on Saltkråkan island with his kids. After fixing up a dilapidated cottage, they return yearly. Pelle, one of the kids, has adventures with friends Tjorven, Stina, and dog Båtsmann.
title: Vi på Saltkråkan

overview: Nano is a story that explores themes of destiny, love in its purest form, and an infinite spirit that triumphs over vengeance. Camila and Manuel are two individuals who share a passion for the ocean and marine life. Camila first sees Manuel—known as "Nano" to his friends—through the massive glass walls of the aquarium where he works. One day, their eyes meet, and they feel an immediate attraction.
title: Nano

overview: Career-driven nonprofit executive Chelsea Martin travels to Paris with her confident rival-turned-ally, Jason Knightly to secure a major donation but a heartfelt message from her late mother – and a loving push from her sister Annabelle – sends her on an unexpected journey to reconnect with the three great loves she once left behind. From the rolling hills of Ireland to the magic of Paris and the sun-kissed vineyards of Spain, Chelsea retraces old footsteps and discovers that sometimes moving forward means first looking back.
title: Paris is Always a Good Idea

overview: When two high school friends, Fuse and Tee, get drunk together after experiencing unexpected heartbreak, a night of blurred lines transforms their friendship—forcing them, along with their circle of classmates, to navigate the messy, confusing realities of secret romance, identity, and growing up.
title: Make it Right 2026

overview: This is the story of Wang Ta-khian village, where a beautiful woman called Phraethong once eloped with her lover Muen Khiri, after being forced to marry Phloeng. However, they were chased and caught by Phraethong, who in his rage killed Meun Khiri. Having witnessed the death of her lover, Phraethong committed suicide. The two dead lovers were buried together under a Ta-khian tree. Hundreds of years passed, however, Phraethong could not enter the rebirth cycle due to committing suicide. Instead, she became Mae Ya Wang Ta-khian, an entity revered by the villagers. All she could do now was wait to meet her lover Muen Khiri again.
title: Ghost of Love

overview: Humanity could not exist without constant progress, the discovery and implementation of new technologies, inventions, and discoveries. What is a discovery? A discovery is always something new, something that didn't exist before, and something that will revolutionize our familiar way of life. It can be the result of lengthy scientific research, or it can come suddenly—as bright as a solar flare. After all, if Nikola Tesla, as a child, watching lightning during a thunderstorm, had believed his parents' explanation that it was a manifestation of God's wrath, we would hardly be using electricity today. And if Albert Einstein hadn't turned the scientific world upside down with his theory, it's unclear what modern physics would be like. What about the theory of evolution? The discovery of atoms? And the countless truly brilliant discoveries made by great scientists of past centuries? Without all of this, the world we are accustomed to would look completely different. And yet, which particular great scientific discoveries played a decisive role?
title: Самые важные открытия человечества

overview: A young savage, Andrei, is brought to Moscow to be civilized. But it's in the concrete jungle that "Mowgli"'s knowledge of the pack's laws comes in handy as he investigates mysterious murders.
title: Маугли. Городские джунгли

overview: As you know, a sapper only makes mistakes twice, and the first time is when choosing a profession. But an employee of the unique division of the Moscow police - the Engineering Department - Major Denis Kramer cannot imagine his life without his favorite job.
title: Точка взрыва

overview: Walking with Cavemen is a four-part television documentary series about human evolutionproduced by the BBC in the United Kingdom. Like previous Walking with... documentaries, Walking with Cavemen is produced in the style of a nature documentary, featuring a voice-over narrator (Robert Winston in the British release, Alec Baldwin in the North American release) who describes the recreations of the prehistoric past as if they were real.
title: Walking with Cavemen

overview: Set at Tinkers Barn, a unique salvage yard in the Suffolk countryside, the series follows three generations of the Warnes family as they rescue, restore and repurpose treasures that others leave behind. Alongside boss Andy is his wife and business partner, Hayley, who focuses on the design and detail that helps transform forgotten finds into desirable pieces. Their son Jonah has been learning the reclaimers trade his whole life, while master craftsman Pops (Andy's dad) – who brings decades of experience and expertise - will be stopping by later in the series. Together, this special family dynamic is a force to be reckoned with as they work to preserve objects from Britain's past while building the future of the family business. Each episode sees the Warnes on their mission to save everything they can find, leaving no stone unturned. With the opportunity to salvage items from old buildings and demolition sites, they try to find a use for anything discarded. From the bricks and mortar of an abandoned property to tired home and garden furnishings, the team scour the likes of castles, schools and hospitals to breathe new life into what was left behind.
title: The Reclaimers: Made in Suffolk

overview: A skilled young public prosecutor is pulled into a brutal prison syndicate led by the brother she thought she lost. Forcing her to choose between justice and family, law and survival, truth and betrayal.
title: Umthetho

overview: Oliver, a young ram, lives contentedly in a flock of sheep and firmly believes that sheep tame humans. He is determined to earn the "Blue Mark" that grants entry to paradise. When he sneaks in among the chosen ones, he discovers the truth. Unfortunately, his warnings fall on deaf ears among the other sheep.
title: Sheep

overview: Through firsthand accounts from families, teammates, and those closest to the cases, each episode of Game Day Murders paints a vivid cultural portrait of the inner workings and emotional stakes of teams, fanbases, and communities faced with tragic consequences.
title: Game Day Murders

overview: Amid fierce court rivalries in the Great Wei Dynasty, Shen Suhe is forced to marry the Second Prince, enduring humiliation before losing her family and life. Reborn on her wedding day, she pretends to be foolish to uncover the truth, joining forces with Prince Yu, Mu Yunzheng, to clear the injustice, defeat the Empress and the Fourth Prince, and eventually live in seclusion together.
title: Snapping Golden Bough

overview: Mark, the gay CEO of an entertainment company, is killed and is given 100 days as a ghost to settle his unfinished business. Cin is a kind shy woman who lives a harsh life with her brother Sun and cruel stepmother and stepsister. Mark discovers he can possess Cin, and together they set out to help Mark's family and business, and solve the mystery of his death (with help from his brother Mate). Along the way, Mark helps Cin improve her own life and find love.
title: The Magical Hour

overview: Celebrating ingenuity, invention and imagination on a grand scale, "Modern Marvels" tells the amazing stories of the doers, dreamers and sometime-schemers who create everyday items, technological advancements and man-made wonders. From the Statue of Liberty to distilled spirits, and canals to bridges, no subject seems out of reach. Science, technology, electronics, mechanics, engineering, architecture, industry, mass production, manufacturing, and agriculture are just some of the many topics that have been covered during the long-running series.
title: Modern Marvels

overview: Walking with Beasts is a 2001 documentary series, produced by the BBC in the United Kingdom, narrated by Kenneth Branagh.
title: Walking with Beasts

overview: When family lawyer Malin and her husband Tobias have the neighbours over for a drink, the police come knocking. The babysitter supposed to be looking after Malin and Tobias's children has been murdered, and Tobias is the primary suspect.
title: Tills döden skiljer oss

overview: Small-town brothers Jagger and Dawson run Young Farts RV Parts, a multi-million-dollar business where they turn trailer trash into cash. Between outrageous schemes, chaotic stunts, and big-hearted hijinks, these brothers chase one wild idea after the next - all for the love of their family and the empire they're building
title: Young Farts Trailer Parts

overview: Take an adventure with Fox Nation host Abby Hornacek as she travels across the country exploring America's most beautiful natural treasures.
title: Park'd with Abby Hornacek

overview: A story about a group of eight teenagers who have bonded inside a bar & restaurant named "HOME". ("HOME" belong to the eldest of the group : Ken who take care everyone and his younger sister "Khaopod," the only girl in the group.) Every members in the group have their own personality, different origin even their own faculty in university. Such as Pol, Man, Jay study at Faculty of Engineering. Sand, Bank study at Faculty of Medicine. Khaopod, Yuan, and Well study at Faculty of Communication (1st year). Friendship and story of problems in each families reveal teenagers' life nowadays. And causing the group of them. All of them think that "HOME" is a home for them. Being the place which contain love, understanding, helping and consulting. Then one day Khaopod accidently shoot a picture, which turn the problem to "HOME". This story will absolutely change her life and all friends' life.

overview: A group of celebrities take turns hosting their own dinner parties and grading each other. Over the week they battle for the title of best host, and the chance to win a grand cash prize for their chosen charity.
title: Come Dine with Me: Celebrity Philippines
